note: WHAT'S NEW screen (docs/whats-new-spec.md). Newest update first; only the newest is shown, once, to returning players. For each player-facing release add an entry at the top with a new id. Entries: one short sentence each, tag NEW / UI / BALANCE / MOVES / AI, optional credit line. Aim for 6 or fewer; past 8 the list scrolls. Plain ASCII apostrophes and quotes.

entries.text: Quit to the title from the phone's CONFIG app.
Clearer phone icons; bigger menus on mobile.
Crits, misses and weak hits look different.
Hung and Looping show; fleeing foes glitch out.
Ten moves got their own animations.
Backspace works in the name box on keyboards.
Battles remember each Forgeling's last move.
Type Feedback with your phone's own keyboard.
Clearer battle text, and bigger battles on phones.
Beating stronger foes levels you up faster.
New moves for Pengwan and Munkboard.
